answer: Start from proof of storage with FRI commitment. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 404 fakes spends 7272 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The hollow of the design is public, the canyon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the juniper of honest work is what finally pays. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
